overview_description.description:
Emboard is an all-in-one AI recruitment and onboarding platform (emboard.io) that streamlines the entire hiring process from sourcing candidates to their first day on the job.
The platform integrates six key stages: sourcing, applicant tracking system (ATS), AI-powered interviews, assessments, offer letter generation, and structured onboarding workflows.
Key features include automated phone and video interviews with AI scoring, skills and language testing in 30+ languages, AI-generated offer letters with e-signatures, and a partner marketplace for services like visas and relocation support.
Emboard aims to solve hiring fragmentation by replacing multiple disconnected tools with one unified platform, claiming to reduce screening time by 50-70% and improve the overall hiring process efficiency.
